scope: The Rolleston Avenue Canterbury Museum in Christchurch as seen in January 2016, including the Mountfort Gothic street ranges, entry porch, roof tower and the connected pre-redevelopment gallery mass. The post-2022 redevelopment, interior galleries and neighboring buildings are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: Street view records the square Gothic roof tower, entry porch and rose window, dark stone with pale quoins and repeated pointed windows. The temporary advertising is outside the building reconstruction.

quallaSearch.notes: One exact published Qualla original by Szilas was accepted under the photographer’s explicit public-domain dedication. The old image with inferred rights and the later redevelopment sign were excluded.
